items.stem: Find the equation of the line parallel to y = 5x + 6 that passes through (2, −4).
items.markingKey: Parallel lines have the same gradient, 5 (B1); −4 = 5 × 2 + c (M1); c = −14, y = 5x − 14 (A1).

Grace leaves home at 10:00. A distance-time graph of the journey shows: a straight line from (0 min, 0 km) to (60 min, 6 km); a horizontal line for 10 minutes; a straight line to 16 km over the next 20 minutes; then a straight line back to home taking 40 minutes. Was the first part or the third part of the journey faster? Explain how you can tell from the graph.
items.answer: Third: the steeper line shows the greater speed (6 km/h compared with 30 km/h).
items.markingKey: B1 steeper = faster (gradient = speed); B1 correct part with values. [2]

items.stem: Explain why a distance-time graph can never slope backwards (to the left).
items.answer: Time always moves forward, so the graph cannot go back to an earlier time.
